name: okf-bootstrap
description: Agent skills (pi, Claude Code) that scaffold two OKF knowledge bundles into a project: design docs with a validator, graph viewer, Mermaid gates and interactive React widgets, and an agent memory bundle (edukai) that re-checks itself through harness hooks.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w okf-widgets
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:views && npm run okf:validate && npm run edukai:validate
scripts.okf:view: npm run build -w okf-widgets && node --import ./skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/okf-start.mjs skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/okf-view.mts okf --widgets skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/templates/okf-widgets/dist/okf-widgets.js
scripts.okf:mermaid:render: npm run build -w okf-widgets && node --import ./skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/okf-start.mjs skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/okf-view.mts okf --check-render --widgets skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/templates/okf-widgets/dist/okf-widgets.js
scripts.demo: npm run build -w okf-widgets && node skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/okf-view.mts examples/demo/okf --widgets skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/templates/okf-widgets/dist/okf-widgets.js
scripts.demo:edukai: npm run demo:edukai:brief && npm run demo:edukai:recheck
scripts.demo:edukai:brief: node skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/okf-edukai.mts index --bundle examples/demo/edukai --now 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z && node skills/okf-bootstrap/assets/okf-edukai-hook.mts brief --bundle examples/demo/edukai --now 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z
